column1: # A target is a domain (subdomains included), or an exact URL / path prefix
# Categories starting with "trap-" are pages that SHARE VOCABULARY with adult
# content but must never be blocked. They are the graduation gate: the text
# blocker leaves beta only if it blocks none of the held-out trap pages. The
# recovery category matters most -- this extension's users visit those sites,
# ---- trap-health: medical, sexual and reproductive health ----
# ---- trap-video: video LISTINGS (added after v4's first eval) ----
# Adult tube pages repeat "videos" dozens of times; benign pages that do the
# same (stock footage, recipe and workout videos, kids' videos, news video
# sections) are what teach the model the word itself is not adult.
